outcome: Risk of death in the presence of post-abortive pelvic peritonitis
cohort: 368 obstetric and gynecological patients admitted to the Kinshasa Reference General Hospital (KRGH) in 2014
finding: Induced abortion-related complications were significantly associated with adolescents, single/separated/divorced women or widows, and patients with a history of induced abortion, with a high mortality rate, especially in the presence of post-abortive pelvic peritonitis.
